Send to Miro and Send to FigJam: before and after the 19 Nov review

Mac frames are real AppKit pixels, not drawings: form-layout-v2/render.swift copies each sheet's SwiftUI (BEFORE from the shipped files, AFTER the proposal), and renders it in a key window with the system's own controls, fonts and metrics, light and dark. Each is shown at 1 pt = 1 CSS px, its real size on a Mac at default scaling; the size is in the frame's bar. The sheet's corner and shadow are the system's and are not drawn. rendered on macOS Version 27.0 (Build 26A428), 2026-11-19 08:08:55 +0000. Web frames are the shipped theme CSS inlined from the tree; AFTER frames add only the one proposed rule. Before / after / variant is in each frame's bar, never inside the UI; a pink line names new keys, proposed copy or sample data. Commentary = the blocks with the hatched edge. Builds on form-layout-four-fixes.html.

Item 2Copy board data stacked under Save Board File… mixed sentence and title case in one pair. AFTER: Copy Board Data, through a desktop.miro.copyBoard override (the browser keeps miro.copyBoard in sentence case, as every web button is). The writing page's rule is one style per element type.
SegmentsTitle case too (Miro App · Developer Access Token). This one is Gruber's inference from Pages' Export sheet: the local HIG copy has no segmented-control page. Easy to leave out.
Found by renderingThis tab is 418 pt tall (434 pt in German), the token tab 400 pt, so the sheet changes height when you switch tabs, although the code comment says it keeps one size. Not in the triaged items; noted, not acted on.

Q1 radiosSticky colours: becomes two named radios, Single colour (yellow) and Sentiment, both shipped strings (miro.colourByNone, miro.colourBySentiment). The checkbox left the off state unnamed.
Why stackedSide by side, the first radio truncates in English (“Single colour…”) as well as German: see the two evidence frames below. Stacking is the radio group's own default layout, so it is the stock primitive, not a fix. Sticky shape stays side by side because its two words fit in every locale; the frame below it shows both rows stacked, if you'd rather they match.
Item 12The long-quotes checkbox moves under Sticky shape, so it no longer reads as a colour option. Same order on all four surfaces: name, colours, shape, checkbox.
Item 2Create board → Create Board (a desktop.miro.createBoard override), beside Cancel.
Item 5The notice loses its em dash: “…to Miro. Hidden quotes are excluded.”
Item 3Not visible: the board-name field is announced as Board name, not by its placeholder, and Sentiment is now read inside the labelled Sticky colours group.
Height400 → 416 pt (438 with both rows stacked). The sheet's minimum is 400, so it grows; nothing is cut.

Commentary · not the product

The horizontal radio group does not wrap: it ellipsises its label, which breaks the labels-never-truncate rule (docs/design-control-labels.md). Neither reviewer could see this from the code. The proposal is the AFTER above (colours stacked, shape side by side); the VARIANT stacks both, 22 pt taller, for a uniform column. Your choice.

Commentary · not the product

Item 7. .bn-board-form sets row-gap: var(--bn-space-sm) (0.35rem, about 6 px), so the stacked Download board file and Copy board data buttons nearly touch. The HIG's accessibility page asks for about 12 pt round a bezelled control. AFTER: var(--bn-space-md) (0.75rem). One line in atoms/modal.css; every form on this page takes it, so each AFTER below is drawn with it.

Item 8 (not visible): Return presses the dialog's primary button, here Copy board data, unless focus is in a field that needs Return.

Form labels. miro.boardNameLabel is reworded in place to the Mac's translated value (Q4, reviewers' lean: no orphan key). New: miro.stickyColoursLabel, a verbatim lift of desktop.miro.stickyColoursLabel, and export.languageLabel. miro.colourByLabel then has no caller and goes.
